summary: Sequans Communications S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 14, 2026 NYSE notice of non-compliance with Section 802.01B: average global market cap below $50M over 30 trading days alongside stockholders' equity under $50M. No immediate delisting; ADSs trade under SQNS with a .BC designation. The company has 90 days to submit a business plan to regain compliance within a nine-month cure period, with NYSE review and determination in 45 days. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or premium is stated. Watch plan acceptance and potential US equivalent of a delisting proceeding.
